task: Hearth & Horizon story from the bible's next-up proposal
errors: First `git checkout -b` failed because the session branch already existed, so the && chain skipped the commit; caught by checking git log, then committed on the existing branch.

doc_friction.issue: 'git log --oneline -15 -- <shelves>' on a shallow clone shows only the last 2-3 commits, so it cannot tell which project has gone longest without a piece; platform/ci/creative_due.py (named in the venture README) is the better pointer and the prompt does not mention it.
The bible is 65 KB, so a plain read is truncated by the tool; the 'grep -n ^##' habit from goals.md would help here too and is not suggested.

deviations.why: The proposal described two cantilevered joists at the front; a pure timber cantilever of a whole gallery is implausible and sound joists were far below their strength under any crowd, so the story uses joists running over a beam with a 1.8 m overhang, notched over the beam (the notch sets the rating).
deviations.did: Modelled an overhanging beam numerically; the moment at the support depends only on the overhang load, which makes 'fill the back' a sharper failed fix (the tip lifts, the root does not change).
deviations.result: Every spoken figure traces to the model in the closing note.

deviations.why: Audio over the 400 MB cap (577 MB).
deviations.did: Text only, as the prompt directs.
deviations.result: Story, pages and feeds landed without audio.
